text:
### If Match Found (True Positive)  
**Immediate Actions:**
1. DO NOT process address change
2. DO NOT notify customer (tipping-off is illegal)
3. Escalate to Head of Compliance immediately
4. Freeze account (no new transactions)
5. File Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) to FCA
6. Await FCA guidance before proceeding  
**Timeline:** FCA response typically 10–30 days
name: Chunk 29/52

raw_entities.name: Match Found Response Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure triggered when a sanctions or PEP list match is confirmed during screening. The process mandates immediate account freeze, compliance escalation, SAR filing, and regulatory coordination with the FCA. No customer notification is permitted due to tipping-off restrictions.
context: Escalate to Head of Compliance immediately
File Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) to FCA

raw_entities.name: Prevent Address Change Processing
raw_entities.description: Immediate action to halt any pending address change request on the matched account. This step prevents the customer from updating their address details while the match is under investigation.

raw_entities.name: Suppress Customer Notification
raw_entities.description: Mandatory step to withhold all customer communication regarding the match or investigation. Notification would constitute illegal tipping-off under AML regulations and compromise the investigation.
context: DO NOT notify customer (tipping-off is illegal)

raw_entities.name: Escalate to Head of Compliance
raw_entities.description: Immediate escalation of the confirmed match to senior compliance leadership for investigation oversight and regulatory coordination. This is the first formal escalation point in the response workflow.
context: Escalate to Head of Compliance immediately

raw_entities.name: Freeze Account
raw_entities.description: Operational action to immediately suspend all transaction activity on the matched account. The freeze remains in place pending FCA guidance and investigation completion.

raw_entities.name: File Suspicious Activity Report to FCA
raw_entities.description: Mandatory filing of a Suspicious Activity Report to the Financial Conduct Authority documenting the sanctions/PEP match and the account freeze. This report triggers formal regulatory engagement and investigation coordination.
context: File Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) to FCA

raw_entities.name: Await FCA Guidance
raw_entities.description: Holding step where the bank awaits formal guidance from the FCA before taking further action on the account or investigation. No account activity or customer contact is permitted during this period.

raw_entities.name: Head of Compliance
raw_entities.description: Senior compliance officer responsible for receiving immediate escalation of confirmed sanctions/PEP matches, overseeing the investigation, and coordinating with the FCA. This role has authority to approve account freeze and SAR filing.
context: Escalate to Head of Compliance immediately

raw_entities.name: FCA
raw_entities.description: The Financial Conduct Authority acts as the external regulatory authority receiving the SAR and providing guidance on investigation and account handling. FCA response typically takes 10–30 days.
context: File Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) to FCA

raw_entities.name: Sanctions or PEP List Match Confirmation
raw_entities.description: Binary decision gate triggered when screening results confirm a customer or account holder matches a sanctions or PEP list. A true positive (match found) initiates the immediate response workflow including account freeze, compliance escalation, and SAR filing.

raw_entities.name: Sanctions and PEP Screening Compliance Gate
raw_entities.description: Mandatory regulatory checkpoint verifying that customer and beneficial owner names have been screened against sanctions and PEP lists. Confirmation of a match triggers immediate escalation and account freeze procedures.
context: Escalate to Head of Compliance immediately

raw_entities.name: Suspicious Activity Report Filing
raw_entities.description: Mandatory filing to the FCA documenting the confirmed sanctions or PEP match and the account freeze action. The SAR initiates formal regulatory investigation and coordination.
context: File Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) to FCA

raw_entities.name: Sanctions and PEP Screening
raw_entities.description: AML screening process that checks customer and beneficial owner names against official sanctions and PEP lists. A confirmed match triggers the immediate response workflow.
context: Escalate to Head of Compliance immediately

raw_entities.name: Matched Account
raw_entities.description: Customer account that has been confirmed to match a sanctions or PEP list and is immediately frozen pending FCA guidance. No new transactions are permitted on this account.
